cases.prompt: Fix suffix_after in src/lib.rs. It must return the text after the first occurrence of a delimiter char, including multibyte delimiters and empty suffixes; return None if missing. Preserve the public API.

files.src/lib.rs: pub fn suffix_after(text: &str, delimiter: char) -> Option<&str> { text.find(delimiter).map(|i| &text[i + 1..]) }

grading.tests:

edits.old_text: pub fn suffix_after(text: &str, delimiter: char) -> Option<&str> { text.find(delimiter).map(|i| &text[i + 1..]) }
edits.new_text: pub fn suffix_after(text: &str, delimiter: char) -> Option<&str> { text.find(delimiter).map(|i| &text[i + delimiter.len_utf8()..]) }
